command: C:\Windows\System32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.exe -NoProfile -Command "`$nodes=@('PE1','PE2','PE3'); `$cmds=@('display ip routing-table','display ip routing-table 1.1.1.1','display ip routing-table 2.2.2.2','display ip routing-table 3.3.3.3','display ip routing-table vpn-instance SH','display ip routing-table vpn-instance SH 10.1.20.254','display bgp vpnv4 all routing-table','display bgp vpnv4 vpn-instance SH routing-table','display bgp vpnv4 vpn-instance SH routing-table 10.1.20.0','display isis route','display isis lsdb','display isis peer','display mpls ldp lsp','display mpls lsp','display mpls ldp session','ping 1.1.1.1','ping -vpn-instance SH 10.1.20.254','tracert -vpn-instance SH 10.1.20.254'); foreach (`$n in `$nodes) { foreach (`$c in `$cmds) { `$u='http://127.0.0.1:3080/v3/projects/CampusNetwork_02/nodes/'+`$n+'/command?cmd='+[uri]::EscapeDataString(`$c); `$r=Invoke-RestMethod -Uri `$u; if (`$r.output -notlike 'Error: Command*') { Write-Output ('---'+`$n+' | '+`$c+'---'); Write-Output `$r.output } } }"
